---
title: "Installation Guide"
---

What you need to do the homeworks and the exam.

## Toolchain

1. **R** (recent release) and **RStudio** (or your editor of choice).
2. **Quarto** — <https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/>.
3. A **LaTeX** engine for PDF output: `quarto install tinytex`.
4. **Git** and a **GitHub account** — all homeworks and the exam are distributed and submitted
   through the course GitHub org.
5. Key R packages: `tidyverse`, `brms` (and its Stan backend), `posterior`, `bayesplot`,
   `marginaleffects`. Follow the in-class setup for the Stan toolchain.

## Submitting

- Accept a homework from the link on the [Schedule](schedule.qmd) — this creates your
  `hw-NN-<username>` repo on the org.
- Do your work in that repo, commit, and push. **Rendering the PDF and pushing is your submission.**
- **Opt-in feedback:** add an open-source `license.md` to the repo to receive automated feedback
  (see [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd)).
